why: Each read shape reports what its calls filtered on: `filtered_on` has one entry per combination of equality fields (`equal`, sorted) and bounded field (`range`, absent when the call bounded nothing), with the number of calls, in code point order. Four range reads over `at` also fixed `station` and one did not; an aggregate over a time range and one fixing `station` are one shape with two entries; a full scan that filtered on nothing says so with an empty `equal`. Names only, never a value. A write takes no filter and has no `filtered_on` at all - absent, not empty, because it was never asked.
